policies.name: no-circular-dependencies
policies.description: Prevents circular dependencies between components. All dependencies must form a directed acyclic graph (DAG).
policies.logic_definition: FOR EACH issue IN project.dependencies: IF issue形成了cycle THEN REJECT
policies.remediation_strategy: Break the cycle by removing or reordering dependencies

policies.name: max-dependencies
policies.description: Limits the maximum number of dependencies per issue to prevent overly complex dependency chains.
policies.remediation_strategy: Split the issue into smaller, more focused issues

policies.name: required-labels
policies.description: Ensures all issues have at least one label for proper categorization.
policies.remediation_strategy: Add appropriate labels to the issue

policies.name: component-ownership
policies.description: Every issue must be assigned to a component for proper ownership tracking.
policies.logic_definition: IF issue.component_id IS NULL THEN REJECT
policies.remediation_strategy: Assign the issue to an appropriate component

policies.name: critical-issue-review
policies.description: Critical priority issues require at least one review before closing.
policies.logic_definition: IF issue.priority == 'CRITICAL' AND issue.reviews < 1 THEN BLOCK_CLOSE
policies.remediation_strategy: Get at least one review approval before closing
